Commentary.Commentary: So that ends our formalities for this game. The hosts proved how dangerous a side they are in the shortest format and cruised through to victory. They clicked together as a unit and will look to carry forward the momentum to clinch the 2-match T20I series. On the other hand, the visitors are a highly capable side and will look to bounce back hard to end the series on even terms. Do join us for all the action from the same venue on 6th April at 1900 local (1330 GMT) for the 2nd T20I. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

SRI LANKA SKIPPER, UPUL THARANGA is delighted with the win and agrees that they have done a good job like the last two series. Praises the efforts from Malinga and Kusal Perera and opines they form a very good T20I side. Continues applauding Malinga and his experience in this format and adds that it helps him a lot as he keeps suggesting what is to be done and what not. On Kusal Perera, he says that in spite of being injured, he came back and played a superb knock. Is a bit disappointed with himself for throwing the start today but hopes to score big in the upcoming match.

BANGLADESH SKIPPER, MASHRAFE MORTAZA says that they started well with the bat, the first six overs were brilliant. Adds that they lost a lot of wickets in the middle overs which was bad. Mentions that they were struggling in the middle overs but Mahmudullah and Mosaddek Hossain batted really well. Adds that they were still 15-20 runs short. Feels that they need to improve in the middle overs with the bat. Further adds the next game will be a pressure-lees as it's his last one. Reckons that the boys need to show character and fightback as they did in the Test series.

MAN OF THE MATCH, KUSAL PERERA says that he tried to finish the game but couldn't do so. Still he is happy with the win. Adds that there were couple of injuries but he recovered well. Mentions that every player has a rough patch but all you need is to back your skill. Ends by saying that they need to win the final match to take the T20I series.

Mortaza used 7 bowlers and that should tell you he tried everything that he could do. Shakib had an off day with both bat and ball. Rahman was expensive at the start but came back well. Taskin too had a tough outing while Mortaza was the only one who made an impact with the ball but didn't prove to be threatening enough. Bangladesh now have lost 8 T20Is in a row, something that would not amuse them. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Bangladesh needed a breakthrough and their skipper, Mortaza, came into action and got a couple of quick wickets to dent the hosts' momentum. However, Kusal Perera stood like a rock and kept on marching with Gunaratne first and then Prasanna. Towards the end he fell prey to Taskin but the damage was already been done by then. He took the game away from the visitors with his audacious striking.

Sri Lanka go 1-0 up in the T20I series and to add to it, they will be elated to register a win at a venue which doesn't favour them much. After restricting Bangladesh to a competitive total, they needed a great start. Skipper Tharanga and keeper Kusal Perera provided them with one and in particular the latter who was in some stunning mood tonight. The duo made full use of the Powerplay and kept the chase on.
FOUR! Thisara Perera finishes off in style! Low full toss, Perera gets under it and lofts it over Ahmed's head for a boundary. SRI LANKA WIN BY 6 WICKETS!

Full length ball outside off, Prasanna hits it down the ground as Ahmed tries to stop it in his followthrough but fails. The mid off fielder half-stops it and deflects it towards long on. Single taken.

SIX! That's smacked! Low full toss around off, Prasanna gets under it and heaves it over mid-wicket. Has got enough distance and elevation on it to get another maximum to his name. Sri Lanka are within the touching distance now. 3 needed from 9 balls.
On a length outside off, Prasanna has a wild heave across the line but misses it completely.
Perera replaces Perera! It's Thisara who walks in next!

OUT! Sri Lanka are still in the driver's seat though with 9 needed from 11 balls. Ahmed bangs in a short delivery on middle, Perera looks to smash it across the line but ends up getting a top edge. The ball lobs over Taskin Ahmed's head. Sarkar comes across to his left from mid off and takes a simple catch. Kusal Perera has to depart but not before playing a brilliant knock.
TASKIN AHMED is back into the attack. 9 needed from 12 balls!
SIX! He's nailed it! A good over till now gets spoiled. Fullish ball on middle and leg, Prasanna smokes it over mid-wicket and clears the fence with ease. This was a terrific and a much-needed hit.
Third man is coming up!
Full toss on middle and leg, Perera swings across the line and gets it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Seekkuge comes down the track and drills the fullish delivery to long off for a single.
Smart bowling from Rahman. The pressure is building up and this is the third dot in a row. He bowls a full and wide delivery outside off, Prasanna throws his bat at it but misses.
Beautifully bowled! Change of pace and it's cutting across Prasanna. He looks to lap sweep it but fails to get any bat on it.
Low full toss, Prasanna pushes it to covers.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN returns!
Fuller length ball outside off, Prasanna looks to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge to square leg for a single. Sri Lanka need 17 from 18 balls.
FOUR! Streaky runs but they all count! Short delivery in lines of the stumps, Prasanna goes for the pull but gets a top edge that flies over the keeper's head and through to the fence.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Muscled away! Short of a length ball on middle, Perera uses his feet and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length outside off, Prasanna places it to point for a single.
Shortish and room on offer, Perera cuts it to deep cover for a single.
MASHRAFE MORTAZA is back into the attack! 29 needed from 24!
Full length ball on middle, clipped nicely to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Great shot! Fullish delivery on middle, Perera goes inside out over covers and earns himself a boundary.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA walks in next!

OUT! Asela has to depart! Full toss around the hips, Gunaratne looks to play it across but gets rapped on the thigh pad as the ball rolls towards short cover. Gunaratne is a bit lazy to take off the blocks and Sabbir Rahman spots it in a flash. Races across, collects it, turns back and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Gunaratne seems to be struggling and the umpires refer it upstairs. The replays show that Gunaratne is short of his ground.
Run out appeal against Gunaratne is referred upstairs! Sabbir Rahman scores a direct hit at the bowler's end and looks confident. Is Asela a goner?

Taskin Ahmed drops a dolly! Saifuddin sees Perera backing away and bowls a fullish delivery outside off, Perera guides it straight towards Ahmed at short third man who makes a mess of a sitter. Can't afford to drop those. A single taken.
On a length in line of the stumps, Perera only manages to hit it to extra cover.
Full delivery outside off, driven to long off for a single. Sri Lanka need 37 from 30 balls.
Fullish delivery outside off, Gunaratne was shaping to drive it through covers but drags it towards mid off. Single taken.
FOUR! Shot! The pressure was building up and Gunaratne answers nicely. Kneels to the fullish delivery on off and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket to find the fence.

In the air... but safe! Floated delivery around off, Perera gets his dancing shoes on and looks to go downtown but gets a top edge that balloons towards the cover region. Luckily for him there is no one stationed there and the ball lands safely.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Perera comes down the track and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Tossed up outside off, Perera tires the fancy reverse sweep but misses it completely.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Perera mistimes his drive down the ground as Ahmed looks to stop with his boot but fails. Single taken.
Banged in short outside off, pulled nicely to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery cutting across Perera. He makes room and places it to deep cover for a single.
Short of a length well outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.

Ouch... that must have hurt! Shortish delivery angling into Gunaratne. He is hurried on by it and goes through with his pull shot across the line. Only manages to get an inside edge and it hits him right into the box. He walks across to his Perera and takes a bit of a breather.
Fullish delivery outside off, Perera looks to drill it down the ground but mistimes it through mid off. Single taken.
SAIFUDDIN is back into the attack!
Shortish delivery outside off, Gunaratne cuts it to the man at point. Sri Lanka are cruising at the moment. They need 51 from 42 balls.
Fullish delivery on leg stump, Perera clips it towards deep mid-wicket and runs one. Looks for the second but it is not on.
A touch short outside off, Asela cuts it nicely through point for a single.

That wasn't far from the off pole! Flatter and quicker delivery outside off, Gunaratne looks to cut it but perhaps the room is not there. Misses it and the ball whizzes past the outside edge into the gloves of the keeper.
Floated around off, eased through mid off for a run.
Tossed up outside off, Gunaratne uses his feet and clips it through wide mid on for a single.
SHAKIB AL HASAN comes back to bowl.
Good length ball outside off, cut hard through point for a single.
On a length on middle, Perera with minimal foot movement looks to block it but gets an inside edge onto his pads and to the on side. Single taken. Ahmed was the only one appealing, don't know why.
Slower delivery outside off, Asela plays it late through point for a single.
Leg bye! Fullish delivery around the pads, Perera looks to play it across but is rapped on the pads as the ball rolls to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! Whipped away in style! Full length delivery on leg stump, Perera with a strong bottom hand hits it really well through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Gunaratne runs it down to third man for a single.
TASKIN AHMED is back on!
Tossed up around off, Perera looks to defend it off his front foot but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
6th T20I fifty for Kusal Perera!

FOUR! It has been a dominating knock from Kusal Perera and it's a truly well deserved half century. Goes deep in the crease to the short delivery and pulls it with authority through square leg to find the fence.

A loud shout for an lbw turned down! Tossed up on leg stump, Perera looks to reverse sweep it but misses to be rapped on the pads. The umpire is not interested in the appeal as it was heading down leg.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to deep cover for a run.
Flatter delivery around off, Perera is cramped for room but manages to cut it to covers. Single taken.
Tossed up around off, eased towards long on for a single.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN comes back into the attack.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Perera gets down and sweeps it hard but finds the man at short fine leg.
Loopy ball around middle, eased down to long off for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Drops it short on middle, pulled through square leg for a single.
Slower through the air around off, Kusal punches it down to long on for a single.
Floats it up around off, Perera gets down and reverse sweeps it towards short third man.
MAHMUDULLAH returns for a bowl.
Back of a length delivery outside off, swatted down to long on for a single.
On a good length and around off, Asela runs it down to third man for a single.
ASELA GUNARATNE is the new man in, replacing Munaweera!

OUT! A soft dismissal! Mortaza with another cutter following the batsman who stays leg side. Munaweera ends up chipping it back to the bowler who accepts it gleefully. Mortaza picks up his second and is leading from the front.
Length ball on middle, Perera slashes it through point for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Munaweera punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller on off, driven towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Saifuddin angles it on the pads, Munaweera is already on the leg side and smartly moves inside. Tickles it through backward square leg to finish the over with a boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle, Perera looks to get on top of it but the ball bounces a bit more. He still somehow pulls it towards mid-wicket and runs one.
On a length and outside off, Munaweera goes for a drive but gets an outside edge down to third man for one.
Slower outside off, dragged down to long on for a single.
A low full toss outside off, Perera hits it square of the wicket on the off side. Shakib comes across to his right, stops it with his boots. A couple taken.
Shortish outside off, flayed past point but will get only one.
The debutant, MOHAMMAD SAIFUDDIN comes into the attack.
Landed outside off, Munaweera steers it down to third man to get off the mark and keep strike.
DILSHAN MUNAWEERA comes out to bat.

OUT! Mortaza gets his opposite number! Hits the deck hard and it keeps climbing, Tharanga just looks to run it down but ends up doing so towards short third man where Mustafizur Rahman dives forward to take it. Bangladesh needed a breakthrough and they have got one. Can they sneak a few more?
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Perera is in some mood tonight! He wants to dispatch everything thrown at him. Mortaza slants it across the batsman and this time Perera crashes it through wide of mid off for a boundary. Once again the strong bottom hand comes into play.
Short of a length ball on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller in length around off, driven towards sweeper cover for a single.
MASHRAFE MORTAZA returns for a bowl.

FOUR! More runs! Rahman doesn't know what to do! Keeps it full this time and gets hit for another boundary. Perera clears the front leg and absolutely drills it on the up down the ground. 11 off the over! What a start for Sri Lanka!
FOUR! What a hit that is! Angles in a length ball on middle, Kusal Perera swivels a touch and murders it in front of square for a rollicking boundary.
Yorker into the blockhole, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower one around off, Upul swings hard at it and gets beaten.
Very full it's almost a yorker, Kusal brings his bat down in time as the ball goes off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Fuller and angling in, driven towards covers for a single.

FOUR! Strong bottom hand, I tell you! Tossed up around off, Perera makes room and wallops it over mid off to find the fence once more. Sanath Jayasuriya used to play these kind of shots! At the moment, Bangladesh are bleeding runs like anything. 16 off the over!
Races down to the pitch of the ball and drags it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery around off, Perera works it in front of square for one.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Shakib bowls a loopy ball around middle, Perera comes down the track and hits it over Shakib's head. Long on was a bit too wide and had to cover plenty of ground and in the end the ball crosses the rope.
SIX! Shot! A touch short on middle and leg, Perera gets inside the line and picks it up nicely. Gets the elevation as well as the distance to clear the deep square leg fence.
Fullish delivery on off, Perera sweeps it towards the fielder at square leg. Tharanga wanted the single but the throw is at the striker's end which allows him to get back in safely.
SHAKIB AL HASAN to roll his arm over now.
Fuller in length and around off, Perera drills it towards mid off and then sets off late. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A quick single taken.
Rahman with a cutter this time, Perera doesn't allow it to dip as he is early into the stroke. Gets it off the toe end towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Low full toss, Tharanga looks to hoick it across the line but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and angling in on middle and leg, KP misses the flick and the ball kisses the pads and rolls on the leg side. Rahman appeals but it was always going down leg. A leg bye is taken.
Keeps it nice and full on the stumps, jammed down to long on for a single.
Rahman hurls a full length delivery on off, crashed straight to the man at mid off.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN to bowl now.
Length ball on middle, pulled down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Gets it away this time! On a length and just around off, Tharanga comes down the track and slaps it through covers. Pierces the gap to perfection and finds the fence.
Makes room, comes down the track to this good length ball and slaps it nicely but finds the man at short extra cover.
Good length just around off, Upul is opened up a bit in his stance and ends up pushing it away.
Length ball on middle, Perera skips down the track and flat bats it past the bowler. Mid on quickly gets to the ball but they steal a single.
Length ball, nipping back in from around middle, Tharanga is hit on the pads as the ball rolls off the pads towards the off side for a leg bye.
MASHRAFE MORTAZA comes into the attack.
Fuller in length and outside off, Perera looks to hit it hard but only manages to meet the thin air. An expensive first over from Taskin, 15 off it!
Leg bye! Comes from around the wicket and angles it on the pads, UT misses the flick as the ball goes off the thigh pad towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.

FOUR! Boom! The runs keep flowing! Back of a length ball on middle, sits up at a nice height as Upul stays back to opt for the pull. Oh that rhymed well, eh? Bludgeons it off the middle of the bat and picks up another boundary.

FOUR! Edged away! Good length delivery outside off, Tharanga looks to heave it across the line but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a boundary. As you would call that, an effective edge!
On a length and outside off, Tharanga punches it towards point.
Wide! Length ball down the leg side, Upul comes inside the line to flick but misses.
Fine leg goes back.
FOUR! Easy pickings those! Length ball on the hips, comes at a nice height as Tharanga lifts one leg and pulls it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Wide! Slants it wide across the batsman, Tharanga still goes after it but the ball is too wide for him.
TASKIN AHMED to share the new ball from the other end.
Short and outside off, Perera slaps it hard but finds the point fielder.
Loopy ball, coming in with the angle, Tharanga flicks it uppishly through square leg for a single.
Comes forward and works it with soft hands towards the leg side. Wants the single but Rahim is quick to deny him.
Slider outside off, Tharanga goes back to cut but it goes on the bounce towards Sabbir Rahman at backward point.
Tossed up on middle, Tharanga is opened up a bit in his stance but manages to defend it.
Flatter delivery in line of the stumps, Perera stays back and works it through mid-wicket for a single and gets off the mark.
We are back for the chase. UPUL THARANGA and KUSAL PERERA to open the batting for Sri Lanka. MAHMUDULLAH to start off with the new ball. Interesting, spin to begin with. Here we go...
